a binary mixture of MA and AA has been grafted on to PA-66 film by the mutual grafting technique in aqueous medium.

the grafting of binary mixtures of methyl acrylamide and acrylamides onto polyamide- 6,6 films using gamma radiation is feasible, and the graft copolymeric films obtained have potential applications as ion exchangers, adsorbents, and flocculants.

grafting of binary mixtures of methyl acrylates and acrylic acid onto polyamide- 6,6 films by the mutual grafting technique in aqueous medium using gamma rays as initiator is a viable method for the production of graft copolymers with enhanced Pg and that the graft copolymbers produced by the method have potential applications.

the graft copolylation of a binary mixture, methyl acrylate +acrylamide, onto polyamide films.
graft copolymerizations of binary mixtures of methyl acrylates and acrylamides onto polyamide-66 films.
graft copolymerizations of a binary mixture (methylene-acrylate + acyloxy-amide) onto poly-amide films by the mutual and simultaneous methods in aqueous media.

the graft copolylation of the binary mixture of methylacrylate and acrlyamide is a complex phenomenon and the effect of each factor on the Pg is dependent on the other factors.
the mutual method is a suitable method for graft copolymerizing a binary mixture onto polyamide-66 films.
the mutual method is an efficient technique for graft copolymerizing the binary mixture (MAA + AA) onto polyamide-66 film.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Pg of binary mixture of methylacrylate + acrylic acid is higher than the individual monomers.
the mutual method is a very effective method for the graft copolymation of the binary mixture onto polyamide film.

the graft copoly-merization of a mixture of monomers onto polyamide film is feasible by using gamma rays as an initiator in an aqueous system by the mutual method, and the percentage grafting is enhanced by using a mixed solvent system of water and an alcohol at certain compositions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a mixture of methyl acrylic acid and acrylic acid is more effective than the individual monomers in the graft copolylation of polyamide film.
a binary mixture of monomers can be successfully grafted onto a polyamide substrate by the mutual method and that the Pg of the mixture is higher than that obtained by the individual monomer.
the grafting of the binary mixture of monomers can be enhanced by the use of a mixed solvent system of water and alcohol.
